verdict.rationale:
Docs confirm DeepInfra is a serverless inference cloud with an OpenAI-compatible API and a broad 'catalog' of models (docs-11, docs-15, docs-30) spanning chat, vision, embeddings, image/video, and speech, but no evidence explicitly names or confirms coverage of the specific open-weight families mentioned in the story (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS). Serverless/pay-per-token nature is well documented (docs-12, docs-24), supporting the 'shared serverless endpoints' half of the claim.
missing for 10: explicit listing/confirmation of specific model families (Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS) in the catalog, independent verification of catalog breadth/currency.
